notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes - 01.10.2018
notes.content:
Happy New Year Everyone,

Welcome to 2019! We’re so happy to be back in the office and working on Forklift Simulator 2019
In only a couple of days we’ve been able to make good progress on the game.

Build Notes
[list]
[*] Added Order Picker Forklift
[*] Fixed bug that caused the brake to be on all the time when Oculus controllers were connected
[*] Ability to switch languages during an exercise
[*] Minor text fixes during loading screen
[*] Fixed issue with Silver Trophies showing the Gold Icon
[/list]
We are still working to get the peripherals working properly when running through steam. We are also working hard to get the controller customization screen integrated. We have plans in the works for new forklift attachments and pallet types. Some of that content could be in as early as next week.

Thanks to you, our forklift fans, for supporting us and hanging in there during our Early Access phase. Without you we couldn’t keep doing what we’re doing. We could use even more feedback. Please write on the forums or to our email. We read EVERYTHING you send us and we respond to EVERY piece of mail:

FLS2019@BlindSquirrelGames.com

Also, tune in to our Twitch channel every Tuesday at 2pm Pacific: https://www.twitch.tv/blindsquirrelgames
We regularly show off the new features of Forklift Simulator 2019 and you can ask the team questions during the stream. Our past episodes are up there as well.

 - Forklift Simulator Team

notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes - 12.20.2018
notes.content:
Happy Forking Holidays,

This is our last update of 2018. ːsteamsadː

We’ve been working hard on new modes and more content that we can roll out early next year. This update is lighter because several of our team are out for the holiday break. We focused on quality of life improvements, minor bug fixing, and some localization issues that arose from our last major update.

[h1]Build Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] VR Motion Controls added to Side Stance Reach Truck
[*] VR controls can now be toggled ON as well as held on with the grip button
(Highlighting a control and clicking will lock that control in, clicking again will release focus on that control)
[*] Added Deadman Pedal functionality on Side Stance Reach Truck
(VR: Left Trigger, Keyboard: EQ, Gamepad: XY, Wheel: Clutch Pedal)
[*] Minor Localization Updates
[*] BUG FIX: TODO String when failing a mission
[*] BUG FIX: Next Exercise button returned to the completion screen
[*] Wheel Support Added… Sort Of
(We’ve tested and confirmed the Logitech G29 Wheel works when running the game outside of steam. To do that Right Click Forklift Simulator 2019 in the steam library list. Click the Local Files tab. Click Brows Local Files… Run Forklift Simulator 2019 or the -VR shortcut. The wheel should work)
Please post on the forums if you’re having troubles with the game and we’ll try to get a fix out for our next update on January 10th.
[/list]

As we mentioned previously, our team is taking some much needed time off for the holidays. We’ve had an incredibly busy year and 2019 is shaping up to be even more busy. We thank everyone who’s been supporting us and cheering us on. We also thank all the people who have joined our community. With your continued support we will have a full launch of Forklift Simulator 2019 with tons of game modes, content, training, and multiplayer!

That said, we would love to hear from you even more. Please send us feedback on the forums or to our email. We read EVERYTHING you send us and we respond to EVERY piece of mail:

Happy Holidays to you all!

 - Forklift Simulator Team
FLS2019@BlindSquirrelGames.com

notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes - 12.14.2018
notes.content:
Hello Forklift Fans,

We're posting this week's update a day late and a proverbial dollar short. We have a surprise for next week and we continue to add features and improve the game.

[h1]BUILD NOTES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added New Forklift: Side Stance Reach Truck + Learning the Basics Lessons
[*] Added Full Localization Support and Temporary "Computer Translations" for 10 languages.
[*] French, Italian, German, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, and Spanish are now supported
(If you want to help with translations please email us)
[*] The game now pauses when you open the pause menu
[*] Improved VR menu functionality, snaps to cardinal direction so you can always see it.
[/list]
[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]

No VR controller support for Side Stance Reach Truck
Loading Screen Text is not localized
"Next Lesson" button for some Side Stance Reach Truck lessons is missing

Like I said, we are posting this update on Friday instead of our target date of Thursday for a few reasons. First, we desprately wanted to deliver the total rewrite of the control system into the game. This controller overhaul will add support for almost every wheel as well as tons of input devices you may be using. Second, almost all of our team is taking off early for the holidays. We wanted to pack as many updates into this build because there will only be a few of us left in the office for next week's update.

On the topic of Holidays. We've had a long year and are looking forward to spending time with our families. We will be out of the office beginning 22.12.2018 and we will return 07.01.2019. After next week our next game update is scheduled for 10.01.2019.

[h1]NEXT WEEK SURPRISE[/h1]

We have everything ready to roll out the controller system upgrade. We just need more time for testing such a major change. On Monday or Tuesday of next week we plan to upload a bonus update. This bonus update is in addition to our standard weekly update.

[h1]NEXT WEEK'S UPDATE[/h1]

Next Thursday we are planning to add the virtual controls for the Side Stance Reach Truck, Bug Fixes for the Side Stance Reach Truck lesson completion, and Oculus controller support.

Keep sending feedback we love it!

Also, if you missed it, we have been playing Forklift Simulator 2019 on our Twitch channel. "[url=https://www.twitch.tv/blindsquirrelgames]Twitch Tuesdays at Two[/url]" (2pm Pacific)

-Forklift Simulator 2019 Team

notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes - 12.06.2018
notes.content:
Hello Forklift Fans,


It's Thursday again and that means another update for Forklift Simulator 2019.  Here are the notes:

[h1] New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Vive Control Support Added
[*] Vive Control Layout Added to Controls Menu
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33908614/fe9f66ca23ec52d9627e2f4bd0c96dcf8a0b7079.jpg[/img]
[*] Display Option added to disable Tunnel Vision Vignette
[*] Display Option readded to reset VR headset location
[*] Forklift does not move when game is paused
[*] Non-VR camera is more realistic, cannot spin 360 when seated
[*] Non-VR camera can be reset by holding R3
[/list]

[h1] Updates / Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Keyboard Controls Updated
[*] Disabled legacy UI panel
[*] Mission Complete Screen Location in VR fixed
[*] VR Credits bug fixed
[/list]


We tried really hard to get wheel support in this patch. It turns out there are more than a few issues with that. So, we are modifying our input system which will allow us to support almost every wheel type ever made in addition to a bunch of other controller types. This should be in next week and it will also come with a full customization screen. You'll be able to modify the button mapping for all supported devices, Mouse and Keyboard, Controller, Wheel, and even some motion controls.

In addition to wheel support, next week we are planning to introduce the side stance reach truck and it's associated training challenges. If things go really well, we might also have the first pass of localization complete. 

Thanks to everyone who's supporting us. We hope these updates are improving the game and making it better. Please let us know in the comments and on the discussion board.

-Forklift Simulator 2019 Team

notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes - 11.29.2018
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Welcome to the first offical patch notes for Forklift Simulator 2019!

Here are the full details:

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed some cases of reversed view in VR
[*] Fixed issues with certain buttons not working when multiple peripherals were plugged in
[/list]

[h1]Feature Improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a vignette during accleration and deceleration in VR mode
(This is our first attempt to reduce or eliminate motion sickness)
[/list]

Thank you for your support!

FLS2019 DEVS
